Title: Public preview: Ephemeral OS disk support in AKS

Body.Content:
Announcing the public preview of ephemeral OS disk for AKS agent nodes. With ephemeral OS disk, you see lower read/write latency on the Agent Nodes OS disk, since the disk is locally attached.  You will also see faster cluster operations like scale or upgrade thanks to faster re-imaging and boot times. During preview you will be able to run node pools with ephemeral OS alongside node pools with network attached OS disks.

Learn More
